key_path: Sign up at signup.sendgrid.com (starts 60-day free trial)
Settings > API Keys > Create (Restricted: Mail Send full access)
Verify sender identity: Single Sender verification (click email link) or Domain Authentication (DNS CNAMEs) before any mail sends
human_gates: manual_approval (new-account review/compliance can suspend or limit accounts)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: no SendGrid-specific CLI login (Twilio CLI does not cover SendGrid keys)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - POST /v3/api_keys; Subuser API for partner provisioning (needs an existing key with api_keys scope)
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: partial - mail_settings.sandbox_mode validates requests without delivering; no test key
agent_native_auth.free_tier: no permanent free tier; 60-day trial at 100 emails/day

mcp.official: docs only - SendGrid docs are indexed by Twilio's docs MCP (https://mcp.twilio.com/docs, no auth). No official product MCP; only community servers
mcp.one_click: via Twilio's Claude connector / Cursor plugin (docs only)

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: no SendGrid-specific llms.txt (docs.sendgrid.com/llms.txt and twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/llms.txt 404); SendGrid pages included in https://www.twilio.com/docs/llms.txt
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: no SendGrid-specific page; covered by twilio.com/docs/ai

time_to_first_call_notes: Signup, 2FA enrollment, key creation and single-sender verification are all human clicks; domain auth adds DNS propagation.
agent_friendliness_justification: Good API and scoped keys, but mandatory 2FA, sender verification, trial-only free plan, and no product MCP or agent auth make it one of the most human-gated email APIs.
best_practice: Granular Restricted API key scopes plus sandbox_mode on the send call for safe agent testing.
biggest_gap: No product MCP, no OAuth/CLI login, and 2FA is mandatory before you can even mint a key.
